dovecote-mail-sound.area: desktop-apps/dovecote.js doveImapAnnounce / dovePlayNewMailAlert (new mail in Dovecote / Dreamscape Mail)
dovecote-mail-sound.action: content: the mail itself; its balloon opens the message
dovecote-mail-sound.switch: Control Panel > Mail > Play sound when new messages arrive (doveMailOptions), and Personalize > Sounds: New Mail Notification
dovecote-mail-sound.note: N7 ok: an item she asked for (mail). Plays once per burst; never on Melaton Mobile (Messaging has its own class).

vista-game-sound.area: desktop-apps/vista-games (Chess, Block Drop and the engine's games): effects and music
vista-game-sound.action: content: the sounds of the game she is playing
vista-game-sound.switch: each game's own Play sounds option, VG.soundEnabled, the desktop sounds switch; Volume Mixer
vista-game-sound.note: N7 ok: her own play - effects answer her moves and the opponent's reply in a game she started; music only while a game runs, faded out on pause / close.

explorer-archive-error-sound.area: explorerArchive.js finishUi (a compress / extract that failed)
explorer-archive-error-sound.action: content: the progress dialog stays with the error text and Close
explorer-archive-error-sound.switch: Personalize > Sounds: Program Error; No Sounds scheme
explorer-archive-error-sound.note: N7 ok: an error that stopped an operation she started.

grimoire-navigate-sound.area: tagWikiSearchModal.js / grimoireRemoteBrowser.js Grimoire browser navigation (address, link, Home, history)
grimoire-navigate-sound.action: content: the page she navigated to
grimoire-navigate-sound.switch: Personalize > Sounds: Start Navigation; No Sounds scheme
grimoire-navigate-sound.note: N7 ok: Vista's click sound for a navigation she made (a click, key, typed address). A window opened with a page navigates silently of nothing else; the 2-minute auto retry of an unavailable page goes through the remote browser and plays no sound.

journal-play-clip.area: journal.js playClip (a voice clip in Melaton Journal)
journal-play-clip.action: content: the recording she pressed Play on
journal-play-clip.note: N7 ok: the media she started; no autoplay.

exception-dialog-sound.switch: Personalize > Sounds: Critical Stop; No Sounds scheme
exception-dialog-sound.note: N7 ok: an error packet for a request that failed while the desktop is up; known-benign packets (metadata miss, unknown packet type, link probes) never raise it. Critical Stop, never a dropped socket.

messenger-im-sound.action: content: the message; a click on its balloon opens the chat
messenger-im-sound.switch: Messenger notification options (soundOn), Personalize > Sounds: New Instant Message
messenger-im-sound.note: N7 ok: a message in a chat she is in; the server's notify flag decides (not her own message, not a chat shown on another client).

planet-switcher-sound.area: planetSwitcher.js (Open Planet Switcher, Planet Selected, Planet Switched)
planet-switcher-sound.action: content: the switcher she opened from Start / the shortcut
planet-switcher-sound.switch: Personalize > Sounds: Open Planet Switcher / Planet Selected / Planet Switched; No Sounds scheme
planet-switcher-sound.note: N7 ok: feedback of her own gesture (open, pick, arrive); the switcher opens only from her Start menu item or key.

planet-switcher-bgm.area: planetSwitcher.js startBgm (innerlight music while the switcher is open)
planet-switcher-bgm.switch: the desktop sounds switch (desktopSounds.isEnabled) and the Volume Mixer; closes with the switcher
planet-switcher-bgm.note: N7 ok: music of an app she opened, like a game; no row of its own, it follows the global sounds switch.

gadget-media-player.area: sidebar-gadgets/gadgetShim.js MediaPlayer (a gadget's Windows Media Player object, e.g. Online Radio)
gadget-media-player.switch: the gadget's own Play / Stop, the tab volume
gadget-media-player.note: N7 ok: media in a gadget she placed and started; a gadget's code, not the shell's.

gadget-play-sound.area: vistaGadgetHost.js vghPlay (System.Sound.playSound of a gadget: Pomodoro, Take a Break, Metronome, Piano)
gadget-play-sound.action: content: the sound of a timer / reminder / instrument gadget she placed and set
gadget-play-sound.switch: remove the gadget or its own options
gadget-play-sound.note: N7 ok: an alarm or timer she set, or an instrument she plays; the shell plays nothing of its own.

winlogon-power-sound.area: winlogonPower.js (Shut Down / Restart / Log Off / Lock sound)
winlogon-power-sound.action: content: the power action she chose (a Cancel dialog first where programs would be closed)
winlogon-power-sound.switch: Personalize > Sounds: Exit Melaton / Melaton Logoff; No Sounds scheme
winlogon-power-sound.note: N7 ok: feedback of her own Start menu / key command. Not played for a restart the server or an update starts without her (those go through restartClientNavigate, which plays nothing).

wm-notes-play-recording.action: content: the recording she pressed Play on
wm-notes-play-recording.note: N7 ok: media she started; no autoplay.

wm-chime-preview.area: wmSettingsChime.js play (Settings > Sounds > Chime: the Play buttons)
wm-chime-preview.note: N7 ok: a preview she asked for. The chime itself (tasks/hour-chime.js) is off as shipped and only runs when she picks Every hour / Every half hour.

wm-teleport-music.area: wmTeleport.js musicStart (Teleport's music while the app is up)
wm-teleport-music.switch: the Off / Vibrate volume bubble (tabVolume muted) and the Ringer level; stops when she leaves the app
wm-teleport-music.note: N7 ok: the music of an app she opened (like a game); starts only inside her Teleport session, never at boot. No row of its own: it follows the media volume.

vzaccess-sms-sound.action: content: the text message and the program's TXT view
vzaccess-sms-sound.switch: VZAccess Manager > Preferences > TXT Messaging > Play sound (default on, as the program ships)
vzaccess-sms-sound.note: N7 ok: a text message that arrived (an item she asked for); the server's notify rule decides; also her Play preview.

window-flash-beep.area: modalUtils.js modalDialogs.flash (a click outside a modal dialog's owner)
window-flash-beep.action: content: the flashing dialog she has to answer
window-flash-beep.switch: Personalize > Sounds: Default Beep (event dialog), No Sounds scheme
window-flash-beep.note: N7 ok: the answer to her own blocked click, as Windows does. No switch fixed (N5): it played the unlisted 'default' event, now the 'dialog' event whose row is Default Beep.

client-shutdown-sound.note: N7 ok where it runs; judged DEAD (no caller in the tree, the Winlogon power paths play their own sound via winlogon-power-sound).

explorer-navigate-sound.area: explorerApplet.js navigateTo (Start Navigation in a folder window)
explorer-navigate-sound.switch: Personalize > Sounds: Start Navigation; No Sounds scheme
explorer-navigate-sound.note: N7 fixed: plays for a navigation she made (a click, address, Back); a window that goes to Computer or Network because its drive or computer went away passes { silent: true } (a device status change, N7).
